These controls help prevent sensitive data exposure as AI agents access enterprise information and act on users’ behalf.

Responses are grounded in available AI adoption, engagement, and consumption data within the user’s authorized scope.

items.description: With Work IQ, Copilot can now retain useful context from how you work in a workspace so future responses are more relevant, consistent, and personalized. Copilot can use saved memory such as workspace details, working preferences, and recurring instructions to reduce repeated setup and help you continue work more efficiently across workspace sessions.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations: Enhanced proforma invoice
items.description: The modern invoice form brings contract information, invoice lines and billable transactions into one workspace, making proforma invoices easier to prepare and review. Billing teams can edit supported transaction details individually or in bulk, review pending charges and track adjustments alongside key financial totals. This reduces navigation and repetitive work while improving visibility and accuracy before invoice confirmation.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations: TZ Independent Milestone Date
items.description: Keeps project billing milestone dates consistent regardless of the signed-in user's local time zone. Using time zone independent milestone dates on quote and contract records helps globally distributed teams work from the same billing date and reduces date discrepancies when exchanging milestone information with finance systems.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - TZ Independent Accounting date
items.description: Provides a time zone independent accounting date for invoiced project transactions in resource-based deployments. Keeping the intended accounting date consistent across users helps prevent local time zone conversions from shifting the voucher date when transactions are posted in finance and operations.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Refund retainers feature
items.description: Supports returning unused retainer balances through the project invoice rather than correcting previously confirmed invoices solely to release the remaining amount. Billing teams can choose whether to retain or refund the balance, simplifying project closeout even when there are no new chargeable transactions.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations: Billing hub updates
items.description: Extends Billing Hub with clearer visibility into transactions that are not ready for invoicing and additional billing views. Billing users gain a more complete picture of the backlog and can manage invoice preparation with fewer manual steps, helping them distinguish work that can be billed from items that still need attention.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Intercompany Expenses in Expense Management
items.description: Customers using Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations for project-based expense management need taxes on intercompany expenses to be processed correctly and consistently, irrespective of whether intercompany tax posting is configured in the source or destination legal entity. This enhancement aims to provide predictable tax treatment across legal entities and reduce configuration-dependent inconsistencies during intercompany expense processing.

items.title: Outlook: Share Availability
items.description: Easily share proposed meeting times directly from your calendar or while composing an email in Outlook. items.description: Credit management in Dynamics 365 Finance has traditionally applied one credit limit to each customer account. That makes it hard to see which parts of a customer's business are using credit and where the risk is. Credit segments let organizations divide a customer's total credit limit into separate allocations by line of business, such as product line, division, business unit or region. items.description: Users will be able to schedule Microsoft Teams channel meetings directly from Outlook Calendar. This streamlines meeting creation and helps keep discussions and meeting content connected in the appropriate channel.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Schedule Teams Channel Meeting from Win32
items.description: Users can now schedule Teams Channel Meetings from Win32 (Outlook classic client)

items.title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
items.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classi

It follows the standard two‑step Exchange Migration Service pattern: an initial analysis phase to validate and assess PST data, followed by execution of the actual migration. items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent recap for DoD
items.description: Intelligent meeting recap uses AI to provide a quick summary of your meeting, highlighting key discussion points, identifying follow-up actions, and offering quick access to significant points such as name mentions, when a screen was shared, individualized speaker markers, topics, and chapters.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ability to separate out the Townhall attendee invites
items.description: This backend change will now address the 'separation of attendee' invites from the events crew. This feature allows the organizers of Townhalls to maintain separate invites for attendees.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Automatic data preservation for high-risk users
items.description: Adaptive Protection in Microsoft Purview helps you protect your organization’s data by integrating dynamic insider risk levels, determined by data related activities, with various policy engines to automatically moving users in and out of policies as their risk levels change over time. The integration with Data Lifecycle Management will automatically apply retention labels to preserve deleted emails and files based on a user’s insider risk level.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call delegation
items.description: Incoming Teams calls don't wait for a break in your day. Intelligent call delegation provides AI-powered calling assistance so you can focus on the conversations that matter most. It answers calls and gathers context, helping you decide whether to pick up and engage the caller. It can also schedule follow-up appointments through an integration with Microsoft Bookings so you can reconnect with callers at a more convenient time.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - DLM Meter Change
items.description: Data Lifecycle Management (DLM) billing will be based on the volume of data retained. For example, any number of non‑Microsoft 365 generative AI prompts and responses that collectively amount to 1 GB of retained data will be billed at $0.25 per GB per month (equivalent to ~$0.0082 per GB per day). In the updated model, DLM is billed based on the total volume of text messages managed by a DLM policy. Each non‑Microsoft 365 generative AI prompt and response is treated as an individual text message

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Improved website compatibility with site troubleshooting controls
items.description: Microsoft Edge is introducing improvements to help users quickly resolve website issues directly from the browser. When a site is not functioning as expected, users may be guided to relevant troubleshooting options such as adjusting tracking prevention settings (e.g., Strict mode) and reviewing site-specific configurations. This experience surfaces relevant actions in-context to help users restore site functionality without navigating deep into settings.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Introduction of secure workflow to bypass legal holds and retention policies
items.description: The first release of Priority cleanup enables admins to create a recurring exception to delete items under a broader retention policy and/or legal hold on Exchange workload. Creating a Priority cleanup will require a separate security role, multiple approvers, and will have a complete audit trail.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Expanded enforcement controls for Data Loss Prevention connectors
items.description: Microsoft Edge for Business is expanding its existing Data Loss Prevention Enterprise Connector capabilities. Administrators will be able to configure more consistent enforcement across download, upload, paste, and print workflows. Additional controls include required bypass justification and administrator-defined guidance.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Reroute conversations to the right queue automatically
items.description: Service representatives can reroute a live voice or messaging conversation when they realize they aren't the right person to help. The representative updates the conversation details, or the details of a linked case, contact, or account, and then selects Reroute. The conversation goes back through classification and route-to-queue rules and is assigned to the right queue automatically, so representatives don't need to know routing rules or choose a queue themselves. The customer stays connected

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes in messages
items.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes shared in messages. By analyzing destinations embedded in QR codes, Teams can identify potential phishing and fraud threats and apply additional protections to malicious content, extending existing URL protection to QR-based attacks.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Event Chat now available for Events optimized for a large audience in GCC, GCC High and DoD
items.description: All users in Events larger than 1,000 users or in any Event optimized for a large audience can now chat with one another in a public event chat in GCC, GCC High and DoD.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Ability for leaders to publish Power BI reports
items.description: Microsoft Viva Insights is extending its report publishing capabilities from analysts to leader personas such as Chief Officers, Managers and their delegates. This enhancement enables leaders to directly distribute curated reports within their organizations through a lightweight publishing experience, complementing the existing report customization features.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files
items.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, text from tables, text from images — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope evaluation control with recipient and site owner lifecycle status
items.description: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scopes will provide administrators with explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, helping ensure policy targeting and scope membership remain aligned with organizational requirements.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
items.description: Apply sensitivity labels to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups to extend the classification and governance you already use for Microsoft 365 groups. The same labels you publish in the Microsoft Purview portal and configure for groups and sites apply automatically to cloud security groups, with no separate label configuration required.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node
items.description: Add an agent node to your workflow to reason over data, call tools, and return a response, all within a single step. The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional development effort, helping teams automate more of their end-to-end processes and reduce operational overhead.
